Lena Park: Quick, low-stakes poll — I need a 20-ish minute 'microwave dinner' playlist. Format: two opener tracks (kick it off) + one closer (wind down). Drop song + 1-word reason. GO!
Samir Gupta: Opener1: "Velvet Morning" — upbeat
Priya Nair: Opener2: "Neon Spoon" — groovy
Tom B: Closer: "Slow Lanterns" — cozy
Jess M: Opener1: "Paper Boats" — nostalgic :heart:
Omar Reyes: Opener2: "Tiny Revolutions" — punchy
Lena Park: Loving the energy. Throw in a quick book rec to pair with the three-song loop? 15–25 min reading vibe.
Priya Nair: Book: "The One-Page Club" (short story collection) — breezy
Samir Gupta: Book: "Metro Notes" — trains + coffee energy, matches opener1
Jess M: Vote: Samir + Jess combo :thumbsup:
Tom B: Also pro tip: play opener1 -> opener2 -> opener1 (shorter) -> closer. Microwave sync achieved. :microwave:
Omar Reyes: If anyone wants a Spotify link I can toss a playlist together. RadioBot: Playlist created: https://spoti.fi/placeholder/1759994321 (private)
Lena Park: Omar you're a hero. Will test tonight and report back with whether my popcorn burns. :popcorn:
Jess M: If it goes well we should stamp it as an official "Redwood Quick-Dinner Mix" :)
Samir Gupta: I'm in. Also, 1-word review system: "Satisfying" / "Too spicy" / "Perfect timing"
Lena Park: Perfect — thanks all. Results posted after dinner.
RadioBot: Reminder scheduled: "Microwave Mix feedback" in 3 hours.
